title.en: Tsuihou Sareta Kishi Suki Seijo wa Kyou mo Shiawase

altTitles.ja: 追放された騎士好き聖女は今日も幸せ（コミック）

altTitles.en: The Knight-Loving Saint is Happy in Her Exile

description.en:
After being accused of being a false saint, a young woman finds herself exiled from the palace, abandoned by the crown prince, who publicly announces the annulment of their engagement. As punishment, she is sent to a dangerous frontier region, ordered to work at the knights' headquarters. However, contrary to expectations, this punishment was not a source of sorrow... In fact, it was the greatest gift she had ever received! The truth that no one knew was that she was absolutely obsessed with knights—or rather, with their muscular, well-built physiques!

Upon arriving at the knights' headquarters, she is greeted by a towering, broad-shouldered commander with a perfectly sculpted physique, and her first thought is: "Is this a blessing from the heavens!?" Thus, her new life begins among the knights she had always dreamed of meeting, surrounded daily by a world of chiseled muscles and raw strength, turning her exile into a dream come true!
description.ja:
偽聖女の疑惑をかけられ、王子から婚約破棄されたシベル。魔物が多く発生する辺境の地へ追放、騎士団寮で働くことを言い渡されるが、人生最大の喜びを感じていた。なぜならシベルは筋肉が…いや、騎士様が大好きなのだった。憧れの騎士団寮で出迎えてくれたのは、鍛え上げられた筋肉で高身長の騎士団長・レオ。

「これは神様のご褒美…？」

騎士様へのよこしまな気持ちと憧れを秘めながら、シベルの新しい日常が始まるーー。
